The yoga and meditation dome
Classes at sunrise and sundown. Between them, the mats are yours.

🔔 Sit and breathe

🧘 Downward dog, warrior, tree… the teacher's voice is slow and kind. You roll up your mat feeling loose and light.
🔔 The bowl hums. In for four, out for four. The festival seems a long way off.
The hot spring: a long soak
♨️ You slide into the warm water up to your chin. Somebody passes round a jug of cold mint tea.
